hashDetails.originalHash: The hash value itself (as uploaded), not the cracked password.

columns.originalHash: The hash value itself (as uploaded), not the cracked password.
columns.domain: The Windows/AD domain extracted from the hash (e.g. NTLM), not a web domain.

status.partial: Hash only partially cracked, e.g. one half of a linked LM/NTLM pair recovered but not the other.

linkDialog.title: LM and NTLM are two different Windows password-hash formats found together in a pwdump-style file.

createJob.canInterrupt: If enabled, this job's tasks can be preempted when a higher-priority job needs the agents.

loopback.label: 'Dry' means no more new passwords are being cracked; this keeps re-running the attack until that happens.

form.ruleOptional: A hashcat rule file that mangles each wordlist entry (e.g. capitalize, append digits) before trying it.
form.allowHighPriorityOverride: If enabled, a higher-priority job may take this job's agents even past its max-agents limit.
form.clientPotfileName_one: Lets the client's own potfile (passwords already cracked for this client) be used as a wordlist source.
form.clientPotfileName_other: Lets the client's own potfile (passwords already cracked for this client) be used as a wordlist source.

validationBanner.resumeReview: Button that reopens the malformed-line review dialog for a paused upload.

deletionProgress.orphansDeleted: Hashes that existed only in this hashlist (not shared with any other) and are now fully removed.
deletionProgress.sharedPreserved: Hashes also used by other hashlists are kept; only this hashlist's reference to them is removed.

confirmDelete.removeFromGlobalPotfile: 'Potfile' = hashcat's store of already-cracked passwords; this also strips this hashlist's cracks from the shared global one.
